newsitem.title: USA: U.S. aggregate demand has been strong--Fed's Meyer.
newsitem.headline: U.S. aggregate demand has been strong--Fed's Meyer.

text.p: Aggregate demand in the U.S. economy has been strong, with consumer spending seen as one of the factors contributing to economic strength, said Federal Reserve Board Governor Laurence Meyer on Thursday.
"That (consumer spending) has been one source of strength," Meyer said.
"The importance is not which component of aggregate demand has been strong, but that aggregate demand has been strong," he added.
Meyer spoke briefly with reporters after a lunch with the Forecasters Club here.
